item.title: Wednesday 10 AM Update, Nov 11
item.description:
The Wednesday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for Veterans Day, November 11, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; Democrats promise a wave of investigations next year as Republicans vow to fight them in committee; Iran says its enriched uranium will never leave the country; the COP31 leaders' summit opens in Turkey; stocks open higher as CoreWeave lifts chip stocks and Nvidia rebounds; Anthropic opens its IPO to Australian retail investors as Australia plans an A I safety regulator; Claude joins video meetings; an urgent fix for N-able's N-central; your X feed; New England governors ask for more heating aid as oil prices ease; and musicians who play bedside for hospitalized veterans. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Wednesday Morning, Nov 11
item.description:
The Wednesday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for Veterans Day, November 11, 2026: Londonderry weather with the full seven-day forecast; the House votes 211 to 204 to shelve the Hegseth impeachment resolution; Trump marks Veterans Day at Arlington as a court-paused arch plan draws a Kennedy family lawsuit; the Abu Dhabi talks end with a planned large prisoner swap but no territorial breakthrough; Iran says Hormuz stays shut until its conditions are met as more tankers are hit; stock futures rise after CoreWeave's results while Nvidia's board hires a former top prosecutor; OpenAI lets businesses claim profiles in ChatGPT; Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon; CISA adds six actively exploited flaws, including a Chrome bug; your X feed; Veterans Day events and New Hampshire home prices; and the room full of cards for Jackie the eagle's caretakers. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

The Tuesday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 10, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; Hegseth calls his impeachment a "political spectacle" ahead of a 5:30 p.m. House vote; Republicans pick their leaders amid calls to delay; day one of the Abu Dhabi talks ends without a breakthrough; a hotter-than-expected October inflation report sinks stocks at the open and lifts rate-hike bets, while gas dips below four dollars; Meta's teen age detection and Apple's A I usage packs; Anthropic's IPO price range and new Claude models; Microsoft's Patch Tuesday and a breach at Fireworks A I; your X feed; the Wild River Fire and a hospital network outage in New Hampshire; and a doorbell-camera moment that raised seventy-six thousand dollars for a caregiver. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

CNBC markets live updates (Nov 10); Yahoo Finance live blog (Nov 10); Nvidia, "Statement From NVIDIA Board of Directors"; CNBC, "Nvidia Jensen Huang probe: What to know" (Nov 9) - The Neuron AI digest, "Everything That Happened in AI Today, Tuesday, November 10" (Meta age detection, Apple usage packs, Qantas) (Nov 10) - Anthropic, "Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering" (Nov 10); CNBC, "Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78" (Nov 10); TechCrunch (Nov 10); Reuters via CBC News (Nov 10); The Neuron AI digest on Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 (Nov 10) - Zero Day Watch, "Patch Tuesday November 2026";
